text.Junkyard:
Junkyard Junkyard.jpg Star Realms (Base Game) Machine Cult Outpst 5 defense 6 1 Scrap a card in your hand or discard pile. 
 How to Play ==
When you play the Junkyard you put a Outpost in play with a defense strength of 5. And you may scrap a card in your hand or discard pile.
 Strategy ==
The Junkyard is an Outpost with a defense of 5, giving you a scrapping ability a decent buy for a cost of 6 trade.
